addSourceDescription: Connect a source to this Agent Knowledge Base — it syncs automatically and stays fresh.
addSourceFailed: We couldn't add this source. Review the settings and try again.
addSourceRequiresSelection: Select at least one crawled page before adding the source.
connectionFailed: We couldn't connect {{provider}}. Re-enter the credential and try again.
connectionNeedsAttentionDescription: Refresh the connection before adding a website source.
connectionRefreshFailed: We couldn't refresh this connection. Try again.
crawlFailed403: The site returned 403 — it may block crawlers or require authentication. Check the URL, adjust crawl options, or try another provider.
crawlFailedDescription: The crawler couldn't finish this preview. Check the URL, adjust crawl options, or try again.
crawlFailedProvider: {{provider}} reported an error. Check the provider connection and try again.
crawlFailedTimeout: The crawl timed out. Try a narrower URL or reduce the maximum page count.
noPagesFoundDescription: The crawler reached the site but found no indexable pages. Try a different URL, or expand crawl options (sub-pages, depth, include paths).
providerCredentialRequiredDescription: Configure credentials for {{provider}} in Data Sources, then return here to connect it.
providerNotConfiguredDescription: Add an API key or endpoint URL to crawl websites with {{provider}}. Your source settings will appear here once it's connected.
sourcesDescription: Where knowledge comes from, how fresh it is, and whether the last sync succeeded.
sourcesEmptyDescription: Connect a website, workspace, or drive — Dify keeps it synced and fresh, so retrieval never breaks.
syncPolicyCustomDescription: First sync runs right after creation, then {{interval}}.
syncPolicyCustomHelp: From 1 hour to 30 days. Will sync {{interval}}.
